polygon_star.src:
import turtle
t = turtle.Turtle()
def polygon(n, size):
    for i in range(n):
        t.forward(size)
        t.left(360 / n)
for n in range(3, 10):
    polygon(n, 40)
t.penup(); t.goto(-50, 30); t.pendown()
for i in range(5):
    t.forward(200)
    t.right(144)
t.setheading(45); t.forward(70.7); t.back(12.5); t.home()
t.right(17.25); t.forward(33)
CHECK = [t]

spiral.src:
import turtle
t = turtle.Turtle()
for i in range(200):
    t.forward(i * 1.5)
    t.left(59)
t.setheading(123.4); t.back(33)
for i in range(37):
    t.right(i * 7.3)
    t.forward(11.1)
CHECK = [t]

circles.src:
import turtle, math
t = turtle.Turtle()
t.circle(50)
t.circle(-30, 90)
t.circle(80, 270, 7)
t.circle(40, steps=6)
t.left(33.3)
t.circle(25.5, -120)
t.setx(10); t.sety(-20)
t.circle(100, 45)
t.goto(37.5, -12.25)
for i in range(36):
    for j in range(2):
        t.circle(100, 60)
        t.left(120)
    t.right(10)
t.radians(); t.left(math.pi / 3); t.forward(50); t.degrees()
t.circle(-63.2, 333)
CHECK = [t]

two_turtles.src:
import turtle
a = turtle.Turtle()
b = turtle.Turtle()
b.left(180)
for i in range(30):
    a.forward(7)
    a.left(13)
    b.forward(5.5)
    b.right(11)
a.goto(b.position())
a.setheading(a.towards(0, 0))
a.forward(a.distance(0, 0) / 3)
CHECK = [a, b]

bars.src:
import turtle
t = turtle.Turtle()
data = {'딸기': 7, '바나나': 3, '포도': 5, '사과': 9}
x = -150
for name, count in data.items():
    t.penup(); t.goto(x, -100); t.pendown()
    t.setheading(90)
    t.forward(count * 20)
    t.right(90)
    t.forward(40)
    t.right(90)
    t.forward(count * 20)
    x = x + 70
CHECK = [t]
